name: ptee-precedence-tiebreak-log
title: Precedence deep-dive: ties and the Log action
summary: When two Calico policies share an order - or have none at all - the tie is broken by policy NAME, alphabetically. And the Log action is non-terminal: it logs and falls through, so whatever rule follows it is the real decider. Two precedence subtleties that decide flows you thought you'd settled.
